about: Round 05, 2026-09-21 — the blind car. Founder: 'we need to have a strong distinction between when the engineer can read a car and when it can't… focus on the things that would still require improving even if it can't read the car.' Twelve of fifteen are asked with NO readable setup, in the three ways that happens: no runs at all (none), a known car with nothing on its sheet (blind-known-car — a real tester's Yokomo MS2.1), and a sheet filled in on a chassis the app cannot name yet (blind-unnamed-sheet-buggy — a real tester's 1/8 nitro buggy, which is also not a touring car). Three are asked with a readable A800RR sheet to check the levers-on-the-sheet line, the rear-toe usual range and the gearing rows. Questions marked 'driver' are real testers' words from production the week of 2026-09-14; the rest repeat round 04 so the two can be read side by side. Run one context at a time: --contexts <context> --only <its ids>.
